from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.vector_search import get_retrieval_review

class Hou_Mcp_Retrieval_Review(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_retrieval_review"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",        "string", widget_type="text", default="review_query")
        self.add_input("intent_text",   "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("query_context", "any")
        self.add_input("results",       "list")
        self.add_input("top_k",         "int",    widget_type="int", default=10)
        self.add_output("score",            "float")
        self.add_output("grade",            "string")
        self.add_output("production_ready", "bool")
        self.add_output("findings",         "list")
        self.add_output("review",           "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action        = str(inputs.get("action") or "review_query").strip().lower()
        intent_text   = str(inputs.get("intent_text") or "").strip()
        query_context = inputs.get("query_context") or {}
        results       = inputs.get("results") or []
        top_k         = int(inputs.get("top_k") or 10)
        try:
            reviewer = get_retrieval_review()
            if action == "review_results":
                rev = reviewer.review_results(
                    dict(query_context) if isinstance(query_context, dict) else {},
                    list(results) if isinstance(results, list) else [],
                )
            elif action == "review_pipeline":
                rev = reviewer.review_pipeline()
            else:
                rev = reviewer.review_query(intent_text, top_k=top_k)
            d = rev.to_dict()
            return {
                "score":            d.get("score", 0.0),
                "grade":            d.get("grade", "F"),
                "production_ready": d.get("production_ready", False),
                "findings":         d.get("findings", []),
                "review":           d,
                "exec_out":         True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_retrieval_review failed: {e}")
            return {"score": 0.0, "grade": "F", "production_ready": False, "findings": [str(e)], "review": {}, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Retrieval_Review
